svg.desc: The tenant mark, and the same strata the icon set is drawn from: a section through a floor, four bands at their true relative thicknesses, the slab stepping one unit proud because coatings are applied on to a slab that was there first. Crew's tile is ink because Crew is used outdoors, against the site; Quote's is paper because a quotation is a document. Drawn on a 16 unit grid, whole numbers only, so every band edge lands on a pixel boundary at 32 and 64. Both call sites round the corners in CSS, so the tile is full bleed. Re-skinning a tenant: replace this file and edit brand.config.json. The Halcyon set is regenerated by make-icons.mjs in halcyon-contractors/brand; NEW-TENANT.md carries the command.
